name: A scan line pulls text out of a photo
looks: A photographed note sits inside corner brackets like a scan target; a thin highlight line sweeps down across it once, and the instant it passes, a card beneath fills in with the extracted text, a small elapsed-time badge and a copy button settling with it.
build: Scan line is a single horizontal bar with a soft glow, translating top to bottom over 500-600ms on a linear ease (deliberately mechanical, not eased, to read as a scan rather than a wipe). Extracted-text card cross-fades in exactly as the line exits the bottom, text already fully set (no typewriter), elapsed badge and copy button fading in last.
sound: A rising electronic sweep under the scan line, a soft confirm tick as the text card lands.
prompt: Frame a photographed document inside corner brackets like a scan target, sweep a single glowing line down across it once, and the instant it clears the bottom, fill in a card beneath with the extracted text plus a small time badge and a copy button.
